content: अमात्र {%a.%} [नास्ति मात्रा इयत्ता यस्य] .²1 Boundless, immeasurable; अमात्रं त्वा धिषणा तित्वेषे <ls>Rv. 1. 102. 7</ls>. .²2 Not whole or entire. .²3 Not elementary. .²4 Having the measure or quantity of the letter अ. .{@-त्रम्@} .²1 Non-measure. .²2 Not a measure or quantity. .{@-त्रः@} The Supreme Spirit.
